title: Add Linear DNI ids to the two TODO comments in epic_14_settings_test.dart's skipped app-info group
why: AG-6 requires every TODO/FIXME to carry a Linear id (DNI-####). These two are bare, inside a group already skip:-wrapped as 'Backlog: app info screen not yet implemented' — when Story 14.4 is picked up there is no ticket link from the test back to tracked work.
recommendation: Add the Story 14.4 Linear id to both, e.g. `// TODO(DNI-####): verify version string display`, or drop the TODOs since the surrounding group/skip reason already documents the backlog status.
acceptance_criteria: Both TODOs either carry a DNI-#### id or are removed.
